t037_phase2_findings: P0 (BLOCKING, 025's own code): reversals.py::_apply_one_entry (~807-839) computes remaining_senses = target_senses[1:] assuming the create linked sense #1 — true for _create_top_level_entry (wrapper Create(index, text, first_sense) links it) but FALSE for _create_sub_entry (raw factory + SubentriesOS.Add, links NO sense and never receives first_sense). Add regression: sub-entry with N senses -> exactly N in SensesRS after apply_reversals.
